name: 会話を始める挨拶カード
prompt: Recreate only the Japanese greeting card shown in the native preview on an exact clean white 390 × 190 canvas. Treat the Japanese native preview as the authority for layout, dimensions, color, button shape, and Japanese text. The original source crop is only the artwork reference: preserve the blue mascot illustration exactly in character, proportions, black outline, green leaf, face, pose, and flat colors. Place it centered at x=144,y=8 with a 102 × 110 px fit-contain box. Center a forest-green (#047857) pill button at x=88,y=140,size=214 × 32 px with 16 px radius and exact centered white Japanese button label 「山田さんに挨拶する」. Keep all canvas space, spacing, and proportions from the preview. The Japanese label is a button label, not a hyperlink; keep it white on green, not blue. Do not include source English text such as “Wave to unicorn,” source app chrome, profile content, people, or extra copy. Add no shadows, borders, decorative elements, gradients, or frame. Render one flat, front-facing app component image with crisp edges and no perspective.
reviewNotes: First pass preserves the Japanese CTA and green/white semantics. Relative to the native 390x190 preview, mascot is about 20% too large and 8px too low; CTA about 30px too wide, 4px too tall and 5px too high; label is slightly large. The pale gray image backing tile in the native preview is missing. Requires second pass.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
